items.summary: The surge in Anthropic's share price also highlights the wealth created for its early investors and founders as the company completed what became the largest IPO in history, raising approximately $81.34 billion.

items.title: Customs should review classification of bulk Scotch whisky imports: GTRI
items.summary: Customs authorities are facing a tariff dispute regarding bulk Scotch whisky imports following the India-UK trade agreement. The classification issue revolves around whether Scotch falls under specific tariff codes for spirits or food preparations. Importers currently classify bulk Scotch under a code that entitles them to reduced duties. Recent changes have led to customs reclassifying these imports, which doubles the duty rate significantly.

items.title: Piyush Goyal calls for trusted India-US supply chains, deeper economic cooperation
items.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal urged India and the US to build trusted supply chains for better collaboration. He highlighted that India's strengths in talent and manufacturing complement America's capital and technology. The minister also encouraged increased partnerships between educational institutions in both nations. Goyal expressed optimism for achieving USD one trillion in exports during the current fiscal year.

items.title: India needs $430 billion in exports in five months to meet FY27 target: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India requires approximately USD 430 billion in exports from November to March to meet its ambitious target. By the end of October, the country had achieved 57 percent of its export goal for 2026-27. October exports reached an all-time high of nearly USD 90 billion, which reflects substantial growth. Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal proposed a target of USD 1 trillion for this fiscal year.

items.title: CIL-led consortium receives LoI from govt to set up rare earth permanent manufacturing facility
items.summary: Coal India Ltd has received a letter of intent to manufacture rare earth permanent magnets with a capacity of 1,200 tonnes. This project will take place over seven years, with two years for pre-construction and five years for operations. The Union Cabinet approved this initiative in November 2025 as part of a financial outlay of Rs 7,280 crore. Rare earth magnets are vital for industries like electric vehicles and aerospace.

items.summary: The UK's competition body says initial findings suggest the ticket-reselling website used drip pricing.

items.title: DIPAM Secretary calls for mobilising domestic savings, deepening capital markets for financing Viksit Bharat
items.summary: Arunish Chawla emphasized the need for improved domestic savings deployment and a diversified financial system. He highlighted the importance of supporting micro, small and medium enterprises through effective policy frameworks. Economic Advisory Council Chairman S Mahendra Dev stated that achieving sustained economic growth requires efficient investment strategies. R Mukundan stressed the necessity of reforming financial access for smaller enterprises alongside larger businesses.

items.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
items.summary: Anuradha Thakur calls upon industry, especially large firms, to pursue public-private partnerships, partner with smaller businesses, and address wage stagnation

items.title: FDA suspends 23 food business licences across Maharashtra, seizes stock worth Rs 2.23 crore
items.summary: In a statement, FDA said the action followed inspections that revealed several violations, including unhygienic preparation, improper storage of food, presence of cockroaches and flies, unclean equipment and failure to maintain mandatory records.

items.title: FM Sitharaman chairs seventh pre-Budget consultation with infrastructure, energy and sustainability experts
items.summary: The government holds these consultations annually to gather input from experts and industry representatives before finalising Budget priorities and proposals.

items.title: Verify legal status of educational institutions before taking admission: UGC tells students
items.summary: The University Grants Commission has issued an advisory regarding the verification of educational institutions. In the advisory, it emphasizes the need to check the legitimacy of institutions before enrolling. Students and parents should independently confirm the claims made by institutions through official sources. The UGC highlights the importance of ensuring recognition and approval from relevant authorities. This guidance aims to prevent financial and academic mishaps for prospective students.

items.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
items.summary: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

items.title: Piyush Goyal, Italy's Tajani seek stronger ties in autos, pharma and technology
items.summary: India and Italy are fostering stronger economic ties through joint ventures and technology partnerships. They seek collaboration in sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and agriculture. The discussions took place during the recent India-Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation meeting in Rome. Participants highlighted the importance of investment partnerships and technology sharing for successful outcomes. Both countries aim to integrate into global value chains effectively.

items.title: India-US FTA could strengthen aerospace partnerships, boost business opportunities: Gautam Singhania
items.summary: Gautam Singhania emphasized the potential benefits of the proposed India-US Free Trade Agreement for aerospace partnerships. He noted that his company, Raymond Aerospace, has long-standing relationships with American firms. The 23rd Indo-US Economic Summit facilitated networking opportunities to strengthen commercial ties between both nations. Various industry representatives explored collaboration possibilities that could benefit both sides. Increased cooperation in aerospace could lead to growth in business opportunities through this trade agreement.

items.title: Lower crude prices, higher diesel cracks restore profitability of oil marketing companies in Q2FY27: Report
items.summary: India's oil marketing companies including IOC, BPCL, and HPCL returned to profitability in the second quarter of FY27. This recovery followed a period of losses in the previous quarter and was supported by lower crude oil prices. Additionally, a rise in diesel refining margins and an increase in pump prices contributed to improved earnings. However, BPCL experienced a weaker recovery compared to the other companies during this period.

items.title: New PUC certificate validity rules notified: What vehicle owners need to know
items.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has announced new rules regarding the validity of Pollution Under Control certificates. These revisions cater to vehicles based on emission standards and age, affecting renewal timelines. For example, BS-VI compliant vehicles will have longer validity compared to older standards. Furthermore, the rules specify how renewals will be processed and when they take effect.

items.title: Wedding bells and travel demand ring in for India's hotels
items.summary: India's hotel industry is projecting healthy revenue growth supported by a strong wedding calendar in 2027. Revenue per available room rose significantly in October due to increased domestic travel and various events. While some growth may moderate due to a favorable base effect, the recovery in foreign tourists is crucial. Bengaluru and Hyderabad showed the highest RevPAR growth in October among major cities.

items.title: FCNR-related costs and benefits yet to fully play out for banks: Report
items.summary: Foreign Currency Non-Resident deposits are expected to significantly influence the performance of Indian banks. The benefits and costs associated with these deposits have not fully materialized for financial institutions. Banks exhibiting a strong position in fixed-rate FCNR deposits may manage rising funding costs more effectively. Variations in loan growth and deposit composition among banks could lead to different performance outcomes.

items.title: Blackstone-backed Aster DM in talks to acquire rival hospitals in deeper India push
items.summary: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd. is currently in discussions to purchase hospitals from Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. The deal is valued at approximately $150 million and could enhance Aster DM's market position. Interest in consolidation within India's healthcare sector has surged among private equity investors in recent years. Blackstone, which has a significant investment in Aster DM, views the company as a key global asset.

items.title: Gilts v kilts: What is happening with Scottish government bonds?
items.summary: MSPs have heard both the pros and cons of the government's plan to launch its first ever bond to the market.

items.title: Jaishankar meets senior Japanese leaders; discusses deeper strategic, economic ties
items.summary: S Jaishankar met with key Japanese leaders in Tokyo to discuss strengthening bilateral cooperation. The focus was on enhancing strategic, economic, and energy security ties between India and Japan. In addition, Jaishankar will co-chair the upcoming India-Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministers' Dialogue. This dialogue aims to review various aspects of defense cooperation and relations. Both nations maintain a Special Strategic and Global Partnership encompassing multiple areas of collaboration.
